thread:
maya: I opened a docs PR proposing a new section in the model card for our reranker models: clarifying score semantics (logits vs normalized scores), a short benchmark table, and SDK examples for doing batch rerank + softmax normalization. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8128 :memo:

jonah: Nice. Can you paste the bench numbers and the exact score math you're recommending? We should be explicit so users don't accidentally compare logits across variants.

emily: Bench: apex-rerank v2 on A100: median latency 18ms/query for 128 candidates, throughput 550 qps single-threaded, memory 10.8GB. Note: quantized variant drops accuracy ~0.8% on NDCG@10 in our eval set.

saha: For score semantics I'd recommend we show both APIs: raw logits (fast path) and a helper to return normalized probs. Add a warning: "Do not compare raw logits across model variants unless calibrated." :warning:

maya: Snippet I added (python):

```python
# raw scores -> top-k rerank
cands = client.rerank.batch(model='apex-rerank-v2', query=q, candidates=list_of_texts)
# returns list of logits per candidate
# to get probs:
import numpy as np
probs = np.exp(cands) / np.exp(cands).sum()
```

jonah: That numpy softmax is fine, but include a numerically stable version in the docs (subtract max). Also show TS example and mention streaming vs batch differences for cost.

emily: Added a small table in PR: column-candidates | median-latency | ndcg@10-delta | note. And a tiny migration checklist for customers moving from apex-rerank-v1 -> v2 (update model name, re-eval threshold, consider recalibration).

saha: Also call out Dedicated: if you use pinned variants and swap quantized vs fp16, calibration could change recall; advise running the eval harness. Add a short CLI command in the model card to compute NDCG on user datasets.

doc-bot: lint-check: passed. link-checker: found 1 broken link -> `/bench/reeval` not found. Flagged in PR comments.

maya: Thanks, fixing link to /bench/eval-harness. Will add numerically-stable softmax and TS example. After 2 approvals I'll merge. @jonah @saha PTAL. Targeting next docs release.

jonah: LGTM for content. Tiny wording nit in the migration checklist.

saha: Approved after adding the Dedicated note.

doc-bot: merge queued. Auto-merge when approvals >=2 and CI green.

maya: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
